_about: A stand-in for the second project's 'Owner decisions needed' issue of 2026-11-24. That project's repository is private, so its text is not copied here; this body keeps its exact shape (four numbered questions 7 to 10, options as '- **A.**' lines, the same forms of recommendation, a closing note inside the last question) and the phrases the page rule reads, in other words. The real body was checked against the rule on 2026-11-24: none of its four questions pages.
title: Owner decisions needed
body:
@owner: questions from the factory's manager. Each has options, a recommendation and a default.

### 7. Dark mode: one page goes dark, the rest of the site stays light (new 2026-11-19)

The quiz page turns dark when the visitor's device is set to dark. The header, the cookie banner and the footer stay light. A reviewer noticed the mix.

- **A.** Keep it as it is until the whole site gets a dark theme.
- **B.** Give the whole site a dark theme (a new item).
- **C.** Keep the quiz page light too, like the rest of the site.

Recommendation: **A** for now, **B** later. This is about how the site looks, so there is no default.

### 8. A closed account: may it sign in again? (new 2026-11-23, #57, PR #64)

When an operator closes an account, PR #64 hides the profile for good and signs the account out, as #57 asks. The account can then sign in again: it sees a notice and its messages, and can delete itself.

- **A.** Keep it so: a closed person can still read their messages and delete their account.
- **B.** A closed account cannot sign in at all (a new item; the person then cannot delete their own data from the app and has to write to support).

Recommendation: **A** (people keep access to their own data; the profile stays hidden). This is about what a person gets, so there is no default; PR #64 can merge either way and B would be a follow-up item.

### 9. May an assistant set up a person's profile from scratch? (new 2026-11-23, #69)

An account that never finished the profile wizard has no profile. The assistant cannot create one, because setting up a profile is person-only today, and `MISSION.md` keeps running the account person-only. #69 is now narrowed to telling such a person to create the profile in the app first.

- **A.** Keep it person-only (what #69 now builds).
- **B.** Let an assistant set up a person's profile when the person allowed it (a schema change and a mission amendment).
- **C.** Let an assistant set up any profile.

Recommendation: **A**. This is scope and touches the mission, so there is no default.

### 10. #60 (an automatic check on profile texts): wording while it is built (new 2026-11-23)

@owner: #60 is unblocked (a technical matter, decided by the manager). It still needs your word on what people read. Not blocking: the builder uses the plan's wording meanwhile.

- The sentences a person sees when their profile is held, and when the check itself failed.
- Whether privacy notice §6 (transfers abroad) and §8 ("no automated decisions") are reworded to cover the check.
- Whether a low-confidence verdict is always shown (the plan says yes).

Recommendation: the builder's wording, privacy §6 and §8 reworded minimally to be accurate, the verdict always shown. This is about what a person sees, so there is no default.

Answered or decided on 2026-11-23/24 and removed: question 11 (#85 merged by the owner), question 6 (Owner decision: option A, built in #55), question 1 (Owner decision: release 0.1.0), question 3 (Manager decision: draft PR #17 closed, rebuilt in #59).
